اشترفوا (form VIII)
# اِشْتَرَفُوا (ištarafū) /iʃ.ta.ra.fuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِشْتَرَفَ (ištarafa)
# اُشْتُرِفُوا (ušturifū) /uʃ.tu.ri.fuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِشْتَرَفَ (ištarafa)
# اِشْتَرِفُوا (ištarifū) /iʃ.ta.ri.fuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِشْتَرَفَ (ištarafa)
